urls.title: URLs to analyze
urls.description: List of website URLs to score against the 4 target categories.

outputLabel.title: Output label
outputLabel.description: Optional. A label for this run — spaces and special characters are fine, e.g. "Architects | Maine, Louisiana & Maryland". The label is saved as-is in a 'label' column on every result row. The dataset name uses a simplified version (letters, numbers and hyphens only, max 40 characters — an Apify requirement), e.g. results-ARCHITECTS-MAINE-LOUISIANA-MARYLAND-v1, and re-running with the same label auto-increments to v2, v3, etc. so nothing gets overwritten. Leave blank to fall back to a run-ID-based dataset name.

geminiApiKey.title: Gemini API Key
geminiApiKey.description: Your Gemini API key, used for AI-based service summaries and verification.

apifyApiToken.title: Apify API Token
apifyApiToken.description: Your personal Apify API token (Console → Settings → Integrations). Needed to look up previous dataset versions for the output label. Only required if you're using the Output label field.
